postSetupUpdates.change: fence.sh: replaced $TASK_SLICE env-var-based slice gating with git-diff-inferred active-slice detection, matching the packaged /setup skill's scripts/gen_hooks.sh update. No more `export TASK_SLICE=<slice>` — the fence now derives the active slice from `git status --porcelain`: the first write to a slice on a clean tree establishes it, a write to a different slice is denied until that slice's changes are committed (or discarded), and a tree already dirty across >1 slice is denied outright until resolved.
postSetupUpdates.howApplied: Hand-patched only the slice_of/active_slices functions and the slice-gating block, NOT a full gen_hooks.sh regenerate-and-overwrite — a blanket regenerate would have reverted this repo's Python-specific customizations (the mypy-baseline deny message in fence.sh, and feedback.sh/gate.sh entirely, which are hand-authored per skillStackSupport above and have no TS-flavored equivalent to regenerate from).
postSetupUpdates.verified: tested directly against this repo's real slice layout (src/grim/{verbs,exec,adapter,seeds}) before landing: clean-tree write allowed, same-slice write allowed after dirtying verbs/, cross-slice write to exec/ denied while verbs/ was dirty, tree restored to clean and re-verified.
